newsitem.title: USA: MFS Communications wins U.K. license.
newsitem.headline: MFS Communications wins U.K. license.

text.p: MFS Communications Co said Thursday its MFS Communications Ltd subsidiary won an international facilities license from the Department of Trade and Industry in the United Kingdom.
"This breakthrough represents the final barrier to full competition in the U.K. market," James Crowe, MFS chairman and chief executive officer, said.

The license allows MFS to offer end-to-end transatlantic and pan-European communications networks in the United Kingdom, MFS said. The company has international facilities licenses in France, Germany, Sweden and the Netherlands in addition to the United States and United Kingdom.
MFS provides communications services to businesses.
Its stock was down 2-1/8 Thursday afternoon to 46-3/8.
